propositions: The query ticket digest is re-sent verbatim in the user message block on every overlap judge call within a batch, consuming full-price input tokens despite being identical and therefore cacheable if moved to the system prompt.

Moving the invariant query digest from the volatile user block into the cacheable system prompt requires at minimum a 1024-token prefix to trigger Anthropic cache write/read on claude-sonnet-4-6, but the measured prefix of 728–875 tokens falls short, resulting in zero cache hits and a measured +5.8% token increase from the orientation paragraph.

Relocating the query digest from inline to a system-prompt reference preserves judgment precision (relation, shared_artifact, confidence identical on all 12 ordered pairs tested) despite changing the prompt's semantic shape from an inline digest to a cross-block pointer.
